post_title: The Benefits of Hiring Interns for Small Businesses

captions.linkedin:
The benefits of hiring interns, for small businesses.

Interns are not just for big graduate schemes. For a small team, the right intern can bring:

1. Fresh ideas and new eyes on old processes
2. Extra capacity for the project stuck on the back burner
3. Digital and social media skills
4. A low-risk way to try before you hire
5. Mentoring experience for your own staff
6. A stronger employer brand with students and universities

Which of these would make the biggest difference to your team?
